    others = sorted([c for c in counts if c != bg], key=lambda x: counts[x])
    
    if len(others) < 2:
        return grid
    
    marker_color = others[0]  # Least frequent
    block_color = others[-1]  # Most frequent non-bg

    # Calculate block dimensions from bounding box

    min_r = min(p[0] for p in block_positions)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in block_positions)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in block_positions)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in block_positions)
    
    h = max_r - min_r + 1
    w = max_c - min_c + 1
